name: editor_docs
description: Every text of the electrical editor page. Documentation: short bullets with **bold** keywords (gate: a list item at most 20 words, a paragraph at most 35, every section with a list or table; vpt/docs.py doc_text_problems), arranged by vpt/editor_page.py into tabs (docs.tabs) and folded details. Hover popups (tips): at most 4 bullets of about 12 words. Status messages, How to, What's new, the Parameters panel texts. One home: the page reads them from here.
title: Elektroplan Editor
intro: Plan where the outlets, switches and lights of a flat go, on top of the architect's drawing. Your plan file is read in this browser and never sent anywhere.

banners.synthetic_more: The drawing is the toolkit's invented sample flat (samples/synthetic_flat.dxf). Open your own plan file to work on your drawing.
banners.own_plan: Plan file: {file} (read in this browser only; nothing is uploaded).
banners.artifact_note: This is the shareable demo. To save files or print, use the GitHub Pages version: {url} (it works once the repository is public). Here: copy the layout or the parameters, and the draft stays in this browser.
banners.pages_note: Files you open are read in this browser only; Save writes to your computer. Nothing is uploaded.

docs.short_answer: **Short answer:** drag symbols onto the plan, connect each switch to its lights, then print (GitHub Pages version) or copy the layout (demo).
quick_start: **Look at the example**: the sample flat opens with one room planned.
**Drag a symbol** from the **Symbols** palette onto the drawing.
**Connect**: click a switch, then each light it works.
**Keep your work**: Save layout (Pages) or Copy layout (demo).
**Print view** → ⌘P / Ctrl+P → Save as PDF (Pages version).

docs.footer: **Elektroplan Editor** · generic toolkit, synthetic sample, no real building data · symbols **UNVERIFIED** until an Elektroplaner confirms them.
docs.symbols_unverified: **UNVERIFIED**: every symbol was drawn by us and not checked against the standard. Ask the Elektroplaner to confirm them.

params_file.label: Parameter file format
bullets: **JSON**, described by schema/el_parameters.schema.json.
**sections** of values (label, value, unit, mark, source), and the **rules** with two rule sets.
Written by **Save parameters**; read by **Load parameters** after its checks.

build.label: Build
bullets: **One code base**, two pages: tools/build_editor.py.
**Every text** comes from presets/editor_docs.json; every value from presets/el_*.json.
**Gates**: short popups, short Documentation text, no dangling link, artifact contract.

callout_pages: **Needs re-export**: the suggestion geometry and the examples are computed when **tools/export_plan.py** exports the plan file.
Changing those here is **saved with the parameters**, but takes effect only **after re-exporting**.
callout_artifact: **Needs re-export**: the suggestion geometry and the examples are computed when **tools/export_plan.py** exports the plan file.
This demo **cannot export** a plan, so those values are shown **read-only** here.

in.label: Zoom in (+)
in.does: Zooms in on the centre of the drawing.
in.keys: pinch, or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel: around the pointer

out.label: Zoom out (−)
out.does: Zooms out from the centre of the drawing.
out.keys: pinch, or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel: around the pointer

pan.label: Pan and zoom
pan.does: Drag the empty drawing to move it. The view never leaves the storey.
pan.keys: drag; pinch or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel; plain wheel scrolls the page

reset.label: Reset view
reset.does: Shows the whole storey again; layer ticks stay.

all-on.label: All layers on
all-on.does: Ticks every drawing layer, also those off in the DXF.

all-off.label: All layers off
all-off.does: Unticks every drawing layer; then tick only what you want.

filter.label: Filter layers
filter.does: Shortens the layer list; the drawing is not changed.

collapse.label: Layers panel (fold)
collapse.does: Folds the layer panel away; remembered when the browser allows.

print.label: Print view
print.does: One A3 landscape page: ticked layers, placed symbols, title row, scale note, legend.

fit.label: Fit storey / Current view
fit.does: In the print view: the whole storey, or the window you zoomed to.

exit-print.label: Exit print view
exit-print.does: Back to the editor, layers and zoom as before.

delete.label: Delete
delete.does: Deletes the selected symbol (with its links) or link.

undo.label: Undo / Redo
undo.does: Takes back, or does again, the last change.

cancel.label: Cancel / stop
cancel.does: Cancels a picked symbol, stops Connect, deselects.

place-key.label: Place with the keyboard
place-key.does: Enter on a palette symbol, then Enter on the drawing: placed mid-view.

print.note: paper_mm, margin_mm: the @page rule of the print stylesheet (generated from these values). title_mm and legend_mm: the heights of the title row and the legend on the printed page; the drawing gets the rest, which is what the scale note is computed from.
print.label: Print to PDF, step by step
steps: **Place** the symbols: a picked symbol and the suggestion rings do not print.
**Tick** the drawing layers and electrical layers you want on paper.
**Zoom and pan** to a part, if you want only a part.
Click **Print view**; choose **Fit storey** or **Current view**.
Press **⌘P** (Mac) or **Ctrl+P** (Windows), or click **Print / Save as PDF**.
**Save as PDF**, paper **A3**, **landscape**, margins **none**, background graphics **on**.
**Save**, then **Exit print view**.
facts: **Scale note**: the plan's page scale changed by fitting the storey (or your view) to A3.
**Tested** in Google Chrome; Safari and Firefox should work the same. Check the preview.
print.demo: **Not in this demo**: open the GitHub Pages version, paste your copied layout there, then Print view.

page.label: The electrical editor
bullets: **One tab per storey** of the plan.
**Drag a symbol** from the palette onto the drawing, or click it, then click the drawing.
**Faint rings** show where the rules suggest a symbol; let go near one and it **snaps** on.
**Rings are suggestions only**: they are not placed and do **not print**.
**Connect**: click a switch, then the lights it works; the page proposes the **switch type**.
**Layout checks** under the drawing: lights, switches, sockets, kitchen, smoke alarms, symbols outside rooms.
**Keep your work** as a layout file (Save or Copy layout); **Open layout** brings it back.

plan.label: Open plan
bullets: Opens a **plan file** (<name>.plan.json) written by **tools/export_plan.py** from your DXF.
**Read in this browser** only; never uploaded.
**Opened**: a valid plan file; its storeys replace the sample.
**Refused as different**: another kind of file, e.g. a layout or parameter file.
**Refused, could not tell**: not JSON, not a valid plan file, or a drawing that does not parse.
**Version 2** lists the **windows**; an older plan file opens with windows **unknown**.
You can also **paste** the file's text anywhere on the page.

paste.label: Paste a file
bullets: **⌘V / Ctrl+V** anywhere on the page outside an input box.
Works for the text of a **plan**, **layout** or **parameter** file.
The page sees **which kind** it is and opens it with the **same checks** as a file.
Any other text is **refused**, with the reason.

storeys.label: Storeys
bullets: **Each storey** has its own tab, symbols and draft.
The **sample flat** has one storey.

layers.label: Drawing layers
bullets: The plan's **drawing layers** of this storey, grouped by **base name**.
**Toggles** per status (Bestand, Abbruch, Neubau), per base name and per layer.
**On screen**: light on a black stage; each CAD colour keeps its hue.
**In print**: dark on white paper.
**Saved** in the layout file and applied again when it is opened.

el_layers.label: Electrical layers
bullets: **One layer per category**: Elektro – Licht, Elektro – Schalter, …
**Links** (Wirkungslinien) have their own layer, Elektro – Verbindungen.
**Untick** a layer to hide it on screen **and in the print**.
The **numbers** count the symbols (or links) on each layer.

set.label: Symbol set
bullets: **Which symbol set** the palette offers; there is **one** so far.
Each set states its **standard**, **edition**, the **source** of its drawings and whether it was **checked**.

unverified.label: UNVERIFIED symbols
bullets: **Drawn for this toolkit** from general knowledge of IEC 60617 (ÖVE/ÖNORM EN 60617; OVE E 8101).
**Not checked** against the standard text or an Elektroplaner's legend.
A symbol **may differ** from the official one.
**Use them to plan** where things go; ask the **Elektroplaner to confirm** them before installation.

palette.label: Symbol palette
bullets: The chosen set's symbols, **grouped by category**, each with its **German and English** name.
**Drag** one onto the drawing (mouse or finger).
Or **click** it (it stays marked), then **click the drawing**; **Escape** cancels.
The palette **folds away** with its title.

place.label: Placing a symbol
bullets: **Drag and let go**: the insertion point lands where you let go.
**Or click** the symbol in the palette, then click the drawing.
**Picked is not placed**: until you click the drawing, the rings are only suggestions.
**Keyboard**: Enter on the symbol, then Enter on the drawing places it mid-view.
Stored in **drawing (model) coordinates**: zoom and pan never move it.
The **same position** a DXF export will use.

select.label: Select and move
bullets: **Click** a placed symbol to select it (dashed box); **drag** to move it.
**Click the empty drawing** to deselect.
**Dragging the empty drawing** pans the view.

rotate.label: Rotate 90°
bullets: **Turns the selected symbol 90°** counter-clockwise about its insertion point (key **R**).
A **socket's stem** points to the wall it sits on: rotate until it does.

delete.label: Delete
bullets: **Deletes** the selected symbol with its links, or the selected link.
**Keys**: Delete or Backspace. **Undo** brings it back.

undo.label: Undo / Redo
bullets: **Undo** takes back the last change: place, move, rotate, delete, connect, apply, open.
**Redo** does it again.
**Keys**: Ctrl/⌘ + Z and Ctrl/⌘ + Shift + Z.
The history is kept **until the page is closed**.

rooms.label: Room of a symbol
bullets: Each placed symbol gets the **id of its room** from the plan file.
**Inside a room's outline**: that room.
Else the **nearest label** of a room without an outline, if close enough.
Else **could not tell**.
Shown when the symbol is **selected**; **saved** in the layout file.

save.label: Save layout
bullets: **Downloads** this storey's layout as <drawing>__<storey>.electrical.json.
Into **Downloads**, or where the browser asks.
Holds the drawing's **checksum and storey**, symbol set, shown layers, symbols and links.
**Nothing leaves** your computer.

save_in_place.label: Save to file (Chrome)
bullets: Only in browsers that **write to a chosen file** (Chrome, Edge).
The **first click** asks where to save.
After that, or after Open layout, each click **saves in place**.

copy_layout.label: Copy layout
bullets: **Copies** this storey's layout (the Save layout JSON) to the clipboard.
Paste it into a **file**, a **message** or **another copy** of this page.
**No clipboard allowed**: the text is shown in a box, selected, to copy by hand.

open.label: Open layout
bullets: Opens a **layout file** saved or copied before (or paste its text).
**Opened**: it belongs to this drawing and storey.
**Refused as different**: another drawing or storey, with the reason.
**Refused, could not tell**: damaged, unknown set, code or rule set, or a forbidden link.
**Replaces** the symbols on this tab; asks first, and **Undo** brings them back.

autosave.label: Draft in this browser
bullets: Every change is kept as a **draft in this browser** (a private window may refuse).
**Closing by mistake loses nothing**: the draft comes back on reopening.
**Not a file**: save or copy the layout to keep it.
**Per browser and per version**: the demo's draft does not appear on the Pages version.
**Discard draft** clears the tab and the draft.

file.label: Layout file format
bullets: **JSON**, described by schema/el_layout.schema.json (fields below).
**Positions** in model (drawing) units; **rotation** in degrees counter-clockwise.
**links**: which switch works which light; **rule_set**: the placement rule set chosen.
**Version 2**; a version-1 file still opens, with no links and the default rule set.

plan_file.label: Plan file format
bullets: **JSON**, described by schema/plan.schema.json, written by **tools/export_plan.py**.
Per storey: the drawing as **SVG**, the layer list, the model-to-drawing transform.
**Rooms, doors, walls** with the checks R1–R5.
The **placement suggestions** of both rule sets and, for one storey, the **examples**.
Holds the DXF's **file name and SHA-256**, never its folder.

privacy.label: Privacy: your drawing stays on your computer
bullets: **One self-contained page**: no server, no analytics, nothing loaded from other sites.
Files you **open or paste** are read by this browser only.
**Drafts** stay in this browser's storage.
**tools/export_plan.py** runs on your computer and writes the plan file there.
The plan file holds the DXF's **name and checksum**, not its folder.

print.label: Print the electrical plan
bullets: **Print view** prints the ticked drawing and electrical layers on **one A3 landscape** page.
With a **title row**, a **scale note** and a **legend** of the symbols placed.
**Only placed symbols print**: suggestion rings and a picked, unplaced symbol do not.
The print view **warns** when a symbol is picked but not placed, or nothing is placed.
**Only in the GitHub Pages version**: the shareable demo cannot print.

symbols.label: Symbols of the set
bullets: Every symbol: **code, names, category, layer**, and what it may be connected to.
**Drawn by us**, at its size in mm on the storey sheet.
**Insertion point** in the middle; +y is the wall side.

connect.label: Connect (switch to light)
bullets: **Connect** turns Connect mode on or off; symbols do not move in it.
**Switches** are marked; everything else is dimmed.
**Click a switch**: what it may control is marked **green**.
**Click each light** it works: a **dashed link** is drawn on Elektro – Verbindungen.
A light it **may not control** is refused; the message names what it may control.
**Another switch** starts again; the **same switch** or **Escape** stops.

links_layer.label: Links (Elektro – Verbindungen)
bullets: **Dashed lines** between switch and light insertion points: not cable routes.
**Untick** the layer to hide them on screen and in print.
**Click a line** to select it (thicker); **Delete** removes it, **Undo** brings it back.
**Deleting a symbol** deletes its links too.

groups.label: Switching groups and the proposed switch type
bullets: A **group** is a set of lights sharing switches (joined by links).
**1 switch**: Ausschaltung (one-way switch).
**2 switches**: Wechselschaltung (two two-way switches).
**3 or more**: Kreuzschaltung (two two-way switches, an intermediate switch per extra place).
**With a push-button**: no proposal (impulse relay or timer: the Elektroplaner decides).
**Only shown**: nothing changes until you click **Apply**.
The **textbook rule**: the actual wiring is for the Elektroplaner.

apply.label: Apply the proposal
bullets: **Swaps** this group's switch symbols to the proposed codes.
**Positions, rooms and links** stay.
**One click**, one Undo step.

rules_select.label: Placement rule set
bullets: **Which values** the suggestions and the layout checks use.
**Starting values (to confirm)**: the default; ours, each with where its idea comes from.
**Elektroplaner values**: empty until provided; every rule says **no value yet** and suggests nothing.
**Saved** in the layout file.

snap.label: Snap to suggestions
bullets: **On** (default): let go within the **snap radius** of a suggestion and it lands exactly there.
It is also **turned to its wall**.
**Off**, or hold **Alt/Option** while letting go: it lands where you let go.

suggestions.label: Placement suggestions (faint rings)
bullets: **Rings** show where the chosen rule set suggests that kind of symbol.
Shown while you **pick, place or move** a symbol; the room under the pointer is **brighter**.
The ring it would **snap to** is **yellow**; rings keep their size at every zoom.
**Rings are not symbols**: they are never saved or printed.
**Hover a ring** for its rule.
**Switches**: beside each door, on the room side, opposite the hinge.
**Sockets**: the middle of each wall piece between doors. **Ceiling lights**: the room centre.
**Kitchen outlets**: along the walls of rooms whose label marks a kitchen.
**Could not tell**: no walls without a room outline; no switch where the door swing is unknown.
**Windows** from the plan: socket and kitchen rings keep clear by **window_margin_m**.
**Older plan file** (windows unknown): a ring may fall in a window niche.
**No rule** for wall lights and the other symbols.

sug_all.label: Suggestions (show all)
bullets: Shows **every suggestion** of the chosen rule set, coloured by symbol category.
**Untick** to hide; while placing, only that symbol's kind is shown.
**Suggestions only**: they are not placed and do not print.

rules.label: Placement rules and their values
bullets: Every rule the suggestions and checks use, with its **value in each rule set**.
One home: **presets/el_parameters.json**.
**To confirm**: a starting value, with where its idea comes from.
**No value yet**: the Elektroplaner has not given one.
**None** is taken from a standard it was checked against.

colours.label: Colours and line widths
bullets: **Screen**: black stage in both page themes; drawing light on black, symbols saturated.
**Lines** keep a fixed width in screen pixels at every zoom.
**Print**: white paper, drawing dark and muted, symbols in print colours and mm widths.
**Contrast**: every symbol colour has at least 3:1 against its background.
All colours and widths in **presets/el_parameters.json**.

hints.label: Layout checks
bullets: A list per storey, **updated with every change**, with counts.
Three outcomes: **ok**, **to look at**, **could not tell**.
**Our starting values**, not from a standard: confirm them with the Elektroplaner.
**Elektroplaner rule set**: no values yet, so most checks say **could not tell**.
**Checks of the plan**, not of the installation.

hint_h1.label: H1 Lights with no switch
bullets: Every **light no link reaches**.
**Could not tell** when no light is placed.

hint_h2.label: H2 Switches with no light
bullets: Every **switch or push-button without a link**.
**Could not tell** when no switch is placed.

hint_h3.label: H3 Doors without a switch
bullets: Every room with a light: **each door** needs a switch within **hint_switch_near_door_m** of its opening.
**Could not tell**: no value in the rule set, a light's room unknown, no door, or no rooms.

hint_h4.label: H4 Rooms without a light
bullets: Rooms of the types in **check_light_room_types** need a light.
**Room type** from the label words; wet rooms from the plan.
**Could not tell**: a room whose type no label word gives.

hint_h5.label: H5 Too few sockets
bullets: Socket outlets per room at least **check_min_sockets_<type>**.
**A double socket** counts two.
**Our starting values**, not from a standard.

hint_h6.label: H6 Kitchen outlets
bullets: Every kitchen: a **cooker outlet** (checks.cooker_codes).
And at least **check_min_appliance_outlets_kitchen** appliance outlets.

hint_h7.label: H7 Smoke alarms
bullets: Rooms of the types in **check_smoke_room_types** need a smoke alarm.
**Our starting rule**: the Austrian rules on smoke alarms were **not checked**.

hint_h8.label: H8 Wet-room zones
bullets: Sockets near a **shower or bath** must keep out of its zones.
The plan knows **no zones**: always **could not tell**; ask the Elektroplaner.

hint_h9.label: H9 Symbols outside every room
bullets: A symbol whose **room could not be told**.
**Could not tell**: move it into a room, or check the plan's room outlines.

dxf_export.label: CAD for the Elektroplaner (DXF)
bullets: **On your computer**, not in the page: the browser has no DXF writer.
**python3 tools/export_layout_dxf.py --dxf your.dxf --layout <layout file> --out <new.dxf>**
**Checks first** that the layout belongs to that drawing and storey (checksum); else nothing is written.
**Keeps the whole drawing** and **adds layers**: one per symbol category, one for the links.
Each symbol a **block** with its code, name, room and **verified = false**.
**Re-reads** the written file: every symbol there, within **position_tol_mm** of its place.
Symbols stay **UNVERIFIED**: a note on the drawing says so.

params.label: Parameters (one file)
bullets: **Every tunable value** in one file: presets/el_parameters.json.
Rules, snap radius, symbol size, room distance, colours, line widths, example symbols.
The **Parameters** page tab (between Editor and Documentation) shows them in **tabs**; hover a name for its source.
**Live**: changes the page now.
**Needs re-export**: suggestion geometry and examples change after **exporting the plan again**.
**Edits** stay in this browser until **Reset**.
Each saved layout records **its parameters** (id, version, SHA-256, edited or not).

params_save.label: Save parameters
bullets: **Downloads** el_parameters.json, with the time and page it was saved from.
For the suggestions: put it at **presets/el_parameters.json** and **export the plan again**.
**Save to file…** (Chrome, Edge) writes back into a file you chose.
Only in the **GitHub Pages version**.

params_copy.label: Copy parameters
bullets: **Copies** the parameters (the Save parameters JSON) to the clipboard.
**No clipboard allowed**: the text is shown in a box, selected.

params_load.label: Load parameters
bullets: Opens a **parameter file** (or paste its text), **checked first**.
**Loaded**: valid, same parameters.
**Refused as different**: another page's parameters, or other sections or rules.
**Refused, could not tell**: not JSON, invalid, or values breaking the rules (contrast below 3:1).

params_reset.label: Reset parameters
bullets: **Throws away** your edits and loaded values.
Back to the parameters **the page was built with**.

example.label: Examples (simple, complex)
bullets: With **no layout of your own**, the example storey opens with the **simple** example.
**Simple**: one room, a ceiling light, a two-way switch at each of two doors, two sockets.
**Complex**: the whole storey, with lights, smoke alarms, switches, sockets, kitchen outlets and a board.
**Generated** by vpt/el_examples.py from rooms, doors and suggestions; nothing placed by hand.
Marked **EXAMPLE**; **never kept** as a draft.
**Change anything** and it becomes your own layout.
**Switching examples** over your own symbols asks first; Undo brings them back.

example_clear.label: Clear example
bullets: **Removes the example** (symbols and links): start from an empty storey.
**Your own layouts** are never touched.

variants.label: Two versions of this page
bullets: **Same code**, two pages (tools/build_editor.py).
**GitHub Pages version**: real work: Save layout, Save to file, Save parameters, **Print view**.
**Shareable demo** (claude.ai artifact): no download, save or print; **Copy** instead.
**Both** open a plan, layout or parameter file, or accept its text by paste.
**Work does not move** between them by itself: copy the layout, paste it in the other.

messages.outside: Let go outside the drawing: nothing placed.
messages.armed: {name} picked, not placed yet: click the drawing to place it (Escape cancels).
messages.armed_rings: {name} picked, not placed yet: click the drawing (near a ring to snap). The {n} rings are suggestions only.
messages.refused_unknown: Refused (could not tell whether it belongs here): {msg}.
messages.replace_confirm: Replace the {n} symbol(s) on this tab with the file's? (Undo brings them back.)
messages.copied_layout: Layout copied to the clipboard ({n} symbol(s), {l} link(s)).
messages.copy_fallback: The browser did not allow the clipboard: the text is in the box below, selected. Copy it with ⌘C / Ctrl+C.
messages.draft_restored: Your unsaved draft of this storey was restored from this browser ({n} symbol(s)).
messages.draft_discarded: Draft discarded: this tab is empty.
messages.discard_confirm: Discard the draft and every symbol on this tab?
messages.missing_layers: {n} layer(s) of the file are not in this storey and were left out.
messages.legend_note: UNVERIFIED symbols: not yet checked against ÖVE/ÖNORM EN 60617 or an Elektroplaner's legend.
messages.connect_on: Connect: click a switch (marked), then click each light it controls. Escape stops.
messages.connect_from: {name} ({code}) picked: click the lights it may control (marked): {allowed}. Others are dimmed.
messages.connect_not_switch: {code} is not a switch or push-button: in Connect mode start with a switch.
messages.ghosts: {n} suggestion(s) for {kind} (rule set: {set}); let go near one to snap (Alt/Option: place freely).
messages.no_rule: No placement rule for {name}: place it freely.
messages.no_links: No links yet: click Connect, then a switch and its light(s).
messages.link_not_allowed: Not connected: {name} ({code}) cannot be worked by {sw}. It may control: {allowed}.
messages.sug_all: Showing all {n} suggestions ({set}): colour = symbol category. Rings are suggestions only: they are not placed and do not print.
messages.print_ok: {n} placed symbol(s) on this storey will print.
messages.print_armed: {name} was picked but not placed: rings are suggestions and do not print. Exit, then click the drawing to place it.
messages.print_none: No electrical symbol is placed on a layer that is on: nothing electrical will print. Rings in the editor are suggestions only.
messages.print_hidden: {n} placed symbol(s) are on electrical layers that are off: they will not print.
messages.params_changed: Parameter changed (kept in this browser; save or copy the parameters to keep them as a file).
messages.params_changed_export: Parameter changed and saved with the parameters: it takes effect after the plan is exported again.
messages.params_reset: Parameters reset to the page's own file.
messages.params_draft: Your edited parameters were restored from this browser (Reset brings back the page's own file).
messages.example_banner_synthetic: EXAMPLE — synthetic flat, not real data.
messages.example_default: Showing the example ({label}): change anything to make it your own, or Clear example.
messages.example_cleared: Example cleared: this storey is empty.
messages.example_replace_confirm: Replace your {n} symbol(s) on this storey with the example? (Undo brings them back.)
messages.paste_unknown: Pasted text refused (could not tell what it is): {msg}.
messages.no_storey: This plan has no storey to show.
messages.empty_storey: No symbols yet: drag one from the palette onto the drawing.
messages.windows_known: Windows: {n} from the plan; socket and kitchen rings keep clear of them.
messages.windows_unknown: Windows unknown (older plan file): a ring may fall in a window niche. Export the plan again.
messages.checks_counts: {ok} ok · {look} to look at · {unk} could not tell

parts.label: Place
steps: **Drag** a symbol from the **Symbols** palette onto the drawing; let go where it belongs.
Or **click** it in the palette, then **click the drawing**: picking alone places nothing.
**Rings** are suggestions: let go near one and the symbol **snaps** onto it.
**Escape** cancels a picked symbol; zoom and pan never move a placed one.

parts.label: Move & edit
steps: **Click** a placed symbol to select it (dashed box); **drag** it to move it.
**Rotate 90°** (key **R**) turns it; a socket's stem points to its wall.
**Delete** (key Delete) removes the symbol or the selected link.
**Undo / Redo** (Ctrl/⌘ + Z) take any change back.

parts.label: Connect
steps: Click **Connect**: the switches are marked, everything else is dimmed.
**Click a switch**: what it may control turns **green**.
**Click each light** it works: a **dashed link** is drawn.
**Escape** or **Connect** again stops.

parts.label: Switch type
steps: **Switching groups** (under the drawing) lists the lights that share switches.
The page **proposes** the type: 1 Ausschaltung, 2 Wechselschaltung, 3+ Kreuzschaltung.
**Apply** swaps the placed switches to the proposal; nothing changes without it.

parts.label: Snap & rules
steps: While you **pick, drag or move** a symbol, **rings** show the suggested spots.
The ring it will snap to turns **yellow**; let go near it.
Untick **Snap**, or hold **Alt/Option**, to place freely.
**Rules** picks the values: starting values (to confirm) or the Elektroplaner's.
**Layout checks** under the drawing say what is **ok**, **to look at** or **could not tell**.

parts.label: Examples
steps: With no layout of your own, the **simple example** opens, marked **EXAMPLE**.
Pick **complex** in **Example** for a whole storey; **Clear example** empties it.
**Change anything** and it becomes your own layout.

parts.label: Keep your work
steps_pages: **Save layout** downloads this storey's layout; in Chrome **Save to file…** saves in place.
**Open layout…** opens a saved file after checking its drawing and storey.
A **draft** is kept in this browser after every change; **Discard draft** clears it.
steps_artifact: **Copy layout** puts the layout's text on the clipboard; paste it into a file.
**Open layout…** (or paste) opens it again after checking its drawing and storey.
A **draft** stays in this browser only: it does not reach the Pages version.

parts.label: Print
steps_pages: **Place** the symbols first: picked symbols and rings do **not** print.
Tick the **layers** you want on paper; zoom if you want only a part.
Click **Print view**: white paper, print colours, a legend of the placed symbols.
**⌘P / Ctrl+P** → **Save as PDF**, A3 landscape, margins none, background graphics on.
steps_artifact: **Copy layout** here, open the **GitHub Pages version**, and paste it there (⌘V / Ctrl+V).
Then **Print view** there: your work does not move between versions by itself.

parts.label: Your own plan
steps: On your computer: **python3 tools/export_plan.py your.dxf** writes **your.plan.json**.
Click **Open plan…** and pick it (or paste its text): it stays in this browser.
Each storey gets a tab; tick the **drawing layers** you want under the symbols.

parts.label: Parameters
steps: Click the **Parameters** page tab, next to Editor: one tab per group.
**Live** values change the page now; **Needs re-export** values after exporting the plan again.
**Copy** (or Save) to keep them; **Load parameters…** checks a file; **Reset** goes back.
Click **Editor** to return: the storey, zoom and layers are as you left them.

parts.label: CAD (DXF)
steps: **Keep the layout** of a storey as a file (Save or Copy layout).
On your computer: **python3 tools/export_layout_dxf.py --dxf your.dxf --layout <layout file> --out <new.dxf>**.
Send the **new DXF** to the Elektroplaner: your drawing plus the Elektro layers.

entries.title: Parameters is a page tab
items: **Parameters** sits beside **Editor** and **Documentation**, so the storey never disappears.
**Editor** brings the storey back exactly as it was: tab, zoom, layers, selection.

entries.title: Windows, layout checks, CAD export
items: **Windows** read from the drawing: socket and kitchen rings keep clear of them.
**Layout checks** H1-H9 with counts: lights, sockets, kitchen, smoke alarms.
**DXF export** (on your computer): the layout as Elektro layers for the Elektroplaner.

entries.title: Shorter documentation, readable parameters, honest print view
items: **Documentation** in tabs, with short bullets and folded details.
**Parameters** in one readable table per group; **Live** or **Needs re-export** explained once.
**Print view** warns when a symbol is picked but not placed: rings never print.

entries.title: The editor in the toolkit
items: **Open plan**: your own drawing, exported on your computer by tools/export_plan.py.
**Two versions**: GitHub Pages (save, print) and a shareable demo (copy, paste).
**Synthetic sample flat** with the simple example (Wechselschaltung in the Wohnzimmer).
**Paste** a plan, layout or parameter file anywhere on the page.
**Light and dark page theme**; the drawing stage stays black.

control.in: **Around the pointer**: pinch, or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel.
control.out: **Around the pointer**: pinch, or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel.
control.pan: **Drag** the empty drawing to move it.
**Pinch** or **Ctrl/⌘ + wheel** zooms at the pointer.
**Plain wheel** scrolls the page, not the drawing.
**Reset view** brings back the whole storey.
control.reset: Layer ticks stay as they are.
control.all-on: **Ticks every drawing layer**, also those off in the DXF.
control.all-off: **Unticks every drawing layer**; then tick only what you want.
control.filter: **Type part of a name** to shorten the layer list.
Only the list: the drawing is not changed.
control.collapse: **Click the title** to fold the panel away.
Your choice is **remembered** when the browser allows.
control.print: **Only placed symbols** print; rings do not.
**Print view** → Fit storey or Current view.
control.fit: **Current view**: the window you zoomed to.
control.exit-print: **Back to the editor**, layers and zoom as before.
control.place-key: **Enter** on a symbol, then **Enter** on the drawing.
electrical.page: **Rings** are suggestions: they do not print.
**Connect**: click a switch, then its lights.
**Save or copy** the layout to keep it.
electrical.howto: **Step by step**: place, connect, keep, print.
electrical.plan: **Read in this browser** only: nothing is uploaded.
**Checked first**: opened, or refused with why.
electrical.paste: **Paste** a plan, layout or parameter file's text.
Opened with the **same checks** as a file.
electrical.storeys: **One tab per storey**, each with its own symbols.
electrical.layers: **Drawing layers** by status, base name and layer.
Shown **light on black**; printed dark on white.
electrical.el_layers: **One layer per category**, plus the links layer.
**Untick** to hide on screen and in print.
electrical.unverified: **Drawn by us**, not checked against the standard.
**Ask the Elektroplaner** to confirm before use.
electrical.palette: **Or click it**, then click the drawing.
electrical.place: **Let go** where it belongs: the insertion point lands there.
**Near a suggestion**: it snaps onto it.
Stored in **drawing coordinates**: zoom never moves it.
electrical.select: **Click** a symbol to select it; **drag** to move it.
electrical.rotate: A socket's stem points **to its wall**.
electrical.delete: **Deletes** the selected symbol (with its links) or link.
electrical.undo: **Undo / Redo** every change: place, move, connect, apply.
electrical.rooms: **Each symbol gets its room** from the plan.
**Inside an outline**, else the nearest label, else could not tell.
electrical.save: Holds symbols, links, rule set, checksum.
electrical.save_in_place: **Chrome / Edge**: saves back into the same file.
electrical.copy_layout: **Copies the layout's text** to the clipboard.
**No clipboard**: the text is shown, selected.
electrical.open: **Opens a layout** (file or paste), checked first.
**Other drawing or storey, or unreadable**: refused, with why.
electrical.autosave: **Draft kept** in this browser after every change.
**Not a file**: save or copy the layout.
electrical.file: **Positions** in drawing coordinates; links; rule set.
electrical.privacy: **One self-contained page**: nothing loaded from elsewhere.
**Your files** are read in this browser only.
electrical.print: **Print view**: ticked drawing and electrical layers.
**Only placed symbols** print; rings do not.
electrical.symbols: **Every symbol** of the set: code, names, layer.
electrical.connect: **Click a switch**: the lights it may control turn green.
**Click each light**: a dashed link is drawn.
electrical.links_layer: **Click a line** to select; **Delete** removes it.
electrical.apply: **Swaps this group's switch symbols** to the proposal.
Positions and links stay; **one Undo** step.
electrical.snap: **On**: let go near a suggestion → lands on it.
**Off**, or hold **Alt/Option**: lands where you let go.
electrical.suggestions: **Rings** show where the rules suggest a symbol.
electrical.sug_all: **Shows every suggestion** of the rule set.
**Colour** = the symbol category it is for.
electrical.rules: **Every rule and its value** in both rule sets.
**To confirm**: a starting value, not from a standard.
electrical.colours: **Screen**: black stage, bright symbols, fixed-width lines.
**Print**: white paper, dark drawing, print colours.
electrical.hints: **Our starting values**, not from a standard.
electrical.hint_h3: **Doors of lit rooms** without a switch nearby.
electrical.hint_h4: **Rooms that need a light** and have none.
electrical.hint_h5: **Rooms with fewer sockets** than our starting minimum.
electrical.hint_h6: **Kitchens** without a cooker outlet or with too few appliance outlets.
electrical.hint_h7: **Bedrooms and halls** without a smoke alarm.
electrical.hint_h8: **Always could not tell**: the plan knows no zones.
electrical.dxf_export: **Adds Elektro layers** to your drawing for the Elektroplaner.
electrical.params: **Own page tab**, next to Editor: **every tunable value**.
**Needs re-export**: after exporting the plan again.
electrical.params_save: **Export the plan again** with it for the suggestions.
electrical.params_copy: **Copies the parameters' text** to the clipboard.
electrical.params_load: **Checks the file** first: loaded or refused.
**Refused**: another page's, invalid, or poor contrast.
electrical.example: **Simple**: one room, two-way switching, two sockets.
**Generated** from the rooms, doors and suggestions.
**Change anything**: it becomes your own layout.
electrical.example_clear: **Removes the example**: start from an empty storey.
electrical.variants: **Pages version**: save, save to file, print.
electrical.layer: **Tick** to show it under the symbols.
